en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having been asked

about two men what had a slave between the two of them, so one of the two emancipated his share. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was harmful, he would be assigned to emancipate the whole of him, or else the slave would have to work regarding the other half’.
